title: Enterprise Frontend Development
text: Build scalable, maintainable, and responsive web applications using React, Next.js, and modern frontend architectures that support complex business workflows and long-term product growth.

title: Performance Engineering
text: Optimize application speed and user experience through code splitting, lazy loading, bundle optimization, and advanced React rendering strategies that reduce load times and improve responsiveness.

title: Scalable Application Architecture
text: Design reusable component systems and predictable state management solutions using Redux Toolkit, Context API, and modern React patterns to support large-scale applications.

title: API & Platform Integration
text: Integrate REST APIs and Backend-for-Frontend services to create reliable, efficient, and maintainable communication between frontend applications and backend platforms.

title: Cloud & Production Operations
text: Diagnose and resolve production issues through cloud-based debugging, log analysis, deployment workflows, and CI/CD practices, ensuring application reliability and stability.

title: Accessibility & User Experience
text: Deliver accessible, responsive, and user-centric interfaces that follow modern web standards and provide consistent experiences across devices and browsers.
